About the job
Mazowia Cargo Group is one of the largest road freight and contract logistics providers in Central and Eastern Europe, with 9,400 employees, 58 terminals in seven countries and revenues of EUR 1.6 billion. Our headquarters are in Warsaw, and our biggest growth market is Germany, where we operate 14 sites.

Over the past years we grew mainly through acquisitions. As a result, we run five ERP systems and three transport management systems. The Management Board has approved a three-year programme to consolidate the landscape on SAP S/4HANA and a single TMS, and to move the remaining on-premises workloads to Microsoft Azure.

We are looking for an experienced interim programme director to lead this transformation until we have built up our own programme organisation.

What you will do
• Take overall responsibility for the programme (budget of EUR 42 million, around 120 internal and external team members)
• Set up the programme governance, the PMO and the reporting to the Management Board and the Supervisory Board
• Steer the system integrator and the cloud provider, including commercial negotiations and change requests
• Drive the template design with the business units in Poland, Germany, Czechia and Romania
• Manage the rollout plan for the first two waves (Poland in Q3 2027, Germany in Q1 2028)
• Build up and coach a permanent programme team that will take over later

What you bring
• 15+ years in IT, of which at least 8 years leading large ERP or IT transformation programmes
• Experience as CIO, IT director or programme director in logistics, retail or manufacturing
• Track record with SAP S/4HANA programmes and cloud migrations
• Strong vendor management and negotiation skills
• Fluent English; Polish or German is a plus

Engagement
• Interim contract for 12 months with an option to extend
• Start: Q4 2026, the exact date is flexible
• Fully remote from any EU country; travel to Warsaw about once a month and to the German sites as needed, travel expenses covered
• Day rate: up to EUR 1,400, depending on experience
